title.en: Qwen Code, MiMo Code and Qoder CLI are available
title.zh: 新增 Qwen Code、MiMo Code 与 Qoder CLI

description.en: Install them from the agent marketplace. Qoder CLI also comes in a China edition.
description.zh: 可在智能体市场中直接安装，Qoder CLI 同时提供国内版。

description.en: Turn it off in Settings → General to stop the agents on this computer and use the app only as a workspace client. It is off on a new installation and turns on when you add your first local agent.
description.zh: 可在「设置 → 通用」中关闭，关闭后本机智能体停止运行，应用仅作为工作区客户端使用。新安装时默认关闭，添加首个本地智能体后自动开启。

title.zh: 智能体安装与启动问题修复

description.en: OpenClaw installs normally again. DeepSeek Harness installs its supported version automatically instead of failing to start. Claude Code works through relays that do not support tool search.
description.zh: OpenClaw 恢复正常安装；DeepSeek Harness 版本不受支持时自动安装受支持的版本，不再无法启动；Claude Code 可通过不支持工具搜索的中转服务正常使用。

description.en: Errors and failed installations state the actual cause, and connection tests no longer report false timeouts.
description.zh: 报错与安装失败时直接说明原因，连接测试不再误报超时。
